Official platform status: native Nintendo Switch release on 2025-03-20 and native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on 2026-02-19. record.worldSummary: Mira is a massive alien planet divided into distinct regions with different climates, ecosystems, creatures, resources, and ruins. New Los Angeles serves as humanity’s base after the White Whale crash.

storyChapters.title: The White Whale and New Los Angeles
storyChapters.body: The White Whale escapes Earth’s destruction but crashes on Mira. Survivors establish New Los Angeles and race to secure humanity’s future.

storyChapters.title: Life on Mira
storyChapters.body: BLADE explores Mira, rescues survivors, studies alien life, and uncovers competing factions and mysteries surrounding the planet.

storyChapters.title: The fight for humanity’s future
storyChapters.body: The story expands beyond the original Wii U release with additional narrative material included in the Definitive Edition.

features: Large seamless regions across planet Mira
Online squads for up to 32 players
record.perfNotes: Nintendo Switch: measured target is 30 fps, with dynamic resolution reaching about 1080p docked and 720p handheld. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: Nintendo officially advertises up to 4K / 60 fps TV and up to 1080p / 60 fps handheld. Actual rendering resolution can differ from output resolution.
record.storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.5 GB for Nintendo Switch and 14.8 GB for Nintendo Switch 2 on the current product page.
record.verdictSummary: A critically well-received, unusually large science-fiction RPG whose strongest qualities are exploration, world scale, customization, and Skell gameplay. Its dense systems and long runtime make it best suited to players who enjoy deep RPG progression.

record.title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
record.description:
A Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive Yoshi adventure set inside a living encyclopedia. Help the talking book Mr. E remember its creatures by exploring colorful habitats, experimenting with creature behavior, and recording discoveries.

Yoshi enters a living encyclopedia to help the mysterious book named Mr. E recover lost knowledge. Each region represents a themed habitat filled with creatures, secrets and behaviors to observe. Collecting observations and restoring knowledge unlocks deeper parts of the world and more chapters. The tone is colorful, curious and family-friendly, emphasizing wonder rather than danger.

record.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics
record.description:
An expanded edition of Ys X: Nordics with quality-of-life improvements, additional story content around Öland Island, new characters, and the Muspelheim challenge dungeon.

Adol Christin and Karja Balta continue their seafaring journey across the Obelia Gulf. The Proud Nordics edition adds new story material centered on Öland Island and additional characters. Political friction, ancient powers and personal development drive the adventure forward. The sea, islands and Nordic-inspired setting define the identity of the world and its pacing.
